text:
maya (Partnerships): quick heads-up — during an architecture review with Acero today we hit a failure that looks tied to the marketplace hardware image. Customer is on Redwood Private (VPC) and the test run crashes during node join. @tomas can you confirm if your marketplace AMI bundles the NIC offload driver?

 t o m a s (HW Partner): seeing this now. our image does include the offload module (v2.3.1) to support throughput. haven’t seen join failures in our CI but configs vary. sending debug build to reproduce.

 sam (Solutions Eng): thanks. can you paste the kernel + dmesg output from the failing node? we need to know if the NIC driver is causing kernel oops or just timing out during kv-cache restore. also reminder: we have the architecture review call tomorrow 10:00 PST — we should triage before then.

 liam (Platform): paste from the failing box we captured:

 ```
 uname -r: 5.15.0-1020
 dmesg tail:
 [  123.456789] nv_offload: loaded v2.3.1
 [  123.789012] rdm-net: firmware mismatch, falling back
 [  124.001234] redwood-runtime: kv-cache restore timeout after 30s
 ```

 deploy-bot: TEST_FAIL job=onboard-acero node=acero-node-3 step=join duration=00:02:43 link=https://ci.redwood/jobs/9981 :rotating_light:

 ana (Customer Success): customer is nervous about tomorrow — they asked if we can roll to a previous marketplace image or disable the HW offload as a stopgap. they want a clear mitigation if the review is blocked.

 sam (Solutions Eng): mitigation option A (quick): patch the node config to disable NIC offload before joining:

 ```yaml
 network:
   features:
     offload: false
 ```

 that'll force software path and should avoid the firmware mismatch. option B: rollback to marketplace image tag 2025-02-11 which doesn't bundle v2.3.1 (we should confirm with Tomas).

 tomas (HW Partner): confirm: 2025-02-11 image uses v2.2.8. weird that CI didn't catch this — we've got a firmware change that is only exercised with certain kernel builds. i'll run a quick reproduce against kernel 5.15.0-1020 and post results in ~15m.

 ryan (Sales): i'll tell Acero we're working the mitigation and will provide a rollback path. please flag if we need exec buy-in. i'll join the call tomorrow as well.

 maya (Partnerships): plan: 1) Sam to produce minimal config patch and steps to disable offload + rollback steps. 2) Tomas to confirm repro and whether a patched image can be published to marketplace by EOD. 3) Liam to run canary join in staging with offload disabled. 4) Ana to communicate to customer with fallback timeline. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/test-sync tomorrow 10:00 PST. owners: @sam @tomas @liam @ana.

 sam (Solutions Eng): quick checklist for call prep:
 - bring the `dmesg` snippet and CI job link
 - have YAML snippet ready to paste into customer repo
 - steps to rollback AMI (tag + commands)

 link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/marketplace-image-fallback (note: runbook needs a small update for the new offload flag)

 liam (Platform): running staging canary now with offload disabled, ETA ~20m. will report pass/fail. if this passes, we can recommend that as the immediate stopgap during the review.

 maya (Partnerships): perfect — thanks everyone. i'll own the customer comms draft and post once liam confirms staging result. after call we should decide whether we need a joint announcement about the marketplace image update or just a partner advisory. :white_check_mark:
